title: When the Orchard Falls Anew
author: Beatrix Whitlock
blurb: Elodie Brightwater, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
